subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close this stale local-client PR as superseded by current main’s official SDK dependency update, or sponsor a rebuilt local-client implementation?
rationale: The branch is protected, dirty, and touches auth-provider/dependency ownership; automation cannot choose between preserving the now-current official SDK path and accepting a new local request/auth implementation.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100027 as the current-main fix for the old dependency chain and close this PR after linking the current-main evidence and remaining release status.

options.title: Rebuild On Current Main
options.body: Ask for a fresh branch that starts from the current provider package/shrinkwrap, preserves the cache-control invariant, and changes only the remaining auth/audit gap.

options.title: Accept Local Client Direction
options.body: Proceed with a local `BaseAnthropic`/`GoogleAuth` client only after explicit owner approval and live Vertex ADC proof showing no auth/header/retry regression.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100027 as the current-main fix for the old dependency chain and close this PR after linking the current-main evidence and remaining release status.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored this branch and also landed the current-main dependency update that appears to supersede its central package-audit fix.
